title: Verify: HeaderOverlay round info unit tests
summary: Unit tests for logo, world, round ID, status and countdown
description: Write unit tests from REQ1 for the ready state.
acceptance_criteria: Ready state text and timer asserted
The round info test passes when run alone

steps.action: Create describe 'HeaderOverlay round info'. Test 'shows logo, world, round id, status and timer': render <HeaderOverlay worldTitle="The Boy's Room" round={roundFixture} /> with roundFixture imported from './fixtures/api' (mirrors the Round type in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts and the GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current response); assert getByText('StoryForge'), the world title, roundFixture.id, roundFixture.status and getByRole('timer').
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/headerOverlay.test.tsx -t "round info"
